name: Holy Symbol of Ravenkind

source.note: A Tarokka treasure (data/tarokka). Curse of Strahd's 2016 numbers as we know them, in our own words; check against the book.

powers.name: Hold Vampires
powers.text: Magic action, 1 charge: every vampire and vampire spawn within 30 ft that can see the symbol makes a DC 15 Wisdom save or is Paralyzed for 1 minute, saving again at the end of each of its turns.

powers.name: Sunlight
powers.text: Magic action, 5 charges: the sunstone blazes with true sunlight, bright for 30 ft and dim for 30 more, for 10 minutes.

summary: A platinum sunburst with a raven at its heart and a sunstone in the raven's claws: it holds vampires fast and calls up true sunlight.
text: Made long ago by the faithful who fought the valley's first vampire, and lost when its last keeper never came home. It holds 10 charges and regains 1d6 + 4 each dawn. Raised by its attuned bearer, it can hold every vampire and vampire spawn near it frozen in place (1 charge), or blaze with true sunlight for ten minutes (5 charges). It is warm to the touch, even in Barovia.
